title: A four-day launch slip at Peak Near Shackleton
objective: Keep a solar-powered lander with a direct-to-Earth radio alive and in contact for a 14-day surface mission on a ridge near Shackleton crater, an Artemis III candidate region at the lunar south pole.
audience_summary: The plan works as scheduled. A four-day launch slip moves the landing into a period when Earth sinks behind the local terrain for longer than the radio-silence limit. Mission Rescue finds a nearby site that works on the delayed date without relaxing any requirement.

original.name: Try a mission: Peak Near Shackleton
requirements_plain: Battery: survive at most 50 h with less than 25% of the solar disk visible
Radio: at most 96 h in a row without Earth in line of sight
Earth in line of sight at least 40% of the mission
Mean visible solar disk at least 50%
At least 24 h of power-lit time and 12 h of Earth contact right after landing

disruption.description: The launch slips four days. The lander arrives on 14 October 2027 instead of 10 October. Mission length and every requirement stay the same.

data_mode.note: Real data only: committed JPL Horizons + LOLA site files (data/sites/). Synthetic placeholder data is never used.

recovery.selection: The first Mission Rescue alternative (in Rescue's own order) that passes, keeps the 14-day duration and the unchanged requirements, and uses real data.

stable: After the 4-day delay: FAIL, on max_communication_blackout only, by at least 12 h over the 96 h limit
Evidence: communication blackout from 2027-10-23T02:00Z to the end of the mission (2027-10-28T00:00Z)
Mission Rescue finds at least one passing recovery with the same 14-day duration and requirements, on real data
The canonical assessment confirms the recovery passes; the comparison agrees with all three verdicts and ranks the recovery first in a single comparability group
incidental: Scores and exact measured values (shown from the live result)
Which recovery Rescue ranks first (the selection rule above decides; the recorded pick is informational)
Generated scenario ids, labels, colours and timestamps
Dataset hashes and method versions (a change flags the example for re-verification but does not by itself invalidate it)
